jobs.description: Product Lines – Asgard Systems Skip to content Home Services Product Lines Demonstrations and Exhibitions HR Departement Careers Contact Home Services Product Lines Demonstrations and Exhibitions HR Departement Careers Contact PRODUCT LINES BLACK RAVEN A tactical counter-UAS air defense system. The system detects the direction and location of an aerial threat using acoustic sensing units, alerts operators, and neutralizes the threat using a remotely operated weapon station. Custom Simulation Systems We develop tailor-made simulation solutions designed to meet the unique operational needs of defense and security organizations. Our high-fidelity simulators combine advanced visualization, interactive user interfaces, and realistic operational scenarios to support training, mission rehearsal, system validation, and decision-making. Every solution is engineered to integrate seamlessly with customer workflows, ensuring maximum realism, flexibility, and operational effectiveness Counter-UAS Detection & Alert System Our Acoustic Counter-UAS Detection & Early Warning System provides advanced, real-time protection against hostile drone threats through intelligent acoustic sensing and classification. Leveraging sophisticated signal processing and AI-driven acoustic analysis, the system continuously monitors the surrounding environment, distinguishing drone signatures from background noise with high accuracy. Once a drone is identified, the system immediately generates visual and audible alerts, enabling operators to assess the threat and respond without delay. Designed for mission-critical operations, the solution enhances situational awareness and force protection while maintaining reliable performance in complex operational environments. Its rapid detection capabilities and intuitive interface make it an ideal solution for military installations, border security, critical infrastructure, and homeland security applications.
